You will be responsible for designing, executing and implementing solutions that drive research excellence, operational efficiency and revenue growth. What you'll do : Partner with stakeholders to frame the problem. Work directly with technical leaders and domain experts to translate ambiguous questions into well-posed analytical problems, align on success metrics, communicate trade-offs clearly, and recommend the most effective approach—ML/AI, classical analytics, or rule-based decisioning—based on impact, constraints, and maintainability Develop methodologies across the full spectrum . Apply and extend methods across supervised learning, unsupervised learning, Generative / Agentic AI, NLP, etc Apply LLMs and agentic systems pragmatically, and drive adoption of evolving capabilities . Continuously evaluate new models, tooling, and patterns; run fast, measurable prototypes; and scale the winners into production RAG/agent workflows—owning evaluation, guardrails, and hallucination control Deliver production ready solutions . Derive approaches from first principles when off-the-shelf methods don’t fit, prototype hands-on, and carry solutions from data cleaning and feature engineering through model development, evaluation, deployment—ensuring quality in terms of its accuracy, stability and scalability Communicate insights in business terms . Convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence key stakeholders and leaders across the organization What you'll need : 3- 6 years in applied ML / applied AI, with hands-on experience building and deploying models in production environments Bachelor's or Master's (or PhD) in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Equivalent demonstrable expertise is welcome Demonstrated experience working across multiple areas such as supervised ML, unsupervised ML, optimization, recommendation systems, forecasting, and LLM/agentic systems/ RAG, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, fine-tuning trade-offs, and vector databases Proven track record of owning solutions end-to-end—from problem framing and method selection to productionization, monitoring, and iteration in real-world environments Experience with graph algorithms is a plus (knowledge graphs, graph traversal, community detection, graph rag etc Experience in business applications such as churn analysis, customer profiling, and recommendation systems NLP techniques: vector databases, embeddings, topic modeling, and fine-tuning of transformer models like BERT to enhance text analytics capabilities Expert-level Python.
